none: PAS NLM-30C6D4: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust probably cuirassed left. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] EXERC [ITVS]. Diameter: 13.8mm, Weight: 0.91gms, die axis: 6
